status: The native Commerce quotation create and draft edit journeys are browser-verified on desktop and mobile. The keyed office-shell hydration blocker was isolated to the Turbopack development HMR restart loop; starting the sales app with the already-supported webpack development bundler mounted the app root, opened the New quotation drawer and saved through the native Next route. Desktop and mobile lists show the native-created quotations and the edited total. Order-revision Money snapshots, purchase orders, fulfillment, invoicing, settlement and returns remain retained, so sales/quotes and sales/orders stay partial.

hydrationFix.rootCause: The sales app was started with Turbopack. Its HMR client received repeated full-relaunch updates (restart/handleApply), so the app root never mounted and only the Next devtools NEXTJS-PORTAL React root existed. Blocking the HMR/devtools chunks stopped reloads but also prevented hydration.
hydrationFix.verificationBundler: The sales app was restarted with the existing supported webpack development bundler. The app root mounted, the New quotation button had React props, the form drawer opened and Save draft posted to the native route. The committed workspace settings still select Turbopack; this is a verification workaround, not a production change.
hydrationFix.notChanged: No auth, SSO, public host, Cloudflared, PostgreSQL or production runtime was changed.
